_about: Wifecraft's Eve body fit table, read by engine/evebody.cpp (parseEveFitTable): one row per Warcraft female model.
enabled: whether the Eve body is put on that model at all; reason says why not (shown in the menus), quality what the desktop renders showed.
fit: factors on the measured fit (girth: every width over the measured hip and shoulder ratios; torso, hips, shoulders, thigh, calf, arm, forearm: one region's
width; neckTuck, neckLift, neckBase, ankleLift: the seams). Numbers checked in desktop renders only (wifecraft/README.md, The Eve body).

defaults.fit: what every row's fit starts from. The proportions (heads, hipRatio, armRatio, handHeads, spread) edit the actor's skeleton while she wears Eve (engine/bodyrig.h): her height made `heads` of the model's own head heights (chin to crown), the hip joints at hipRatio of it, shoulder to fingertip armRatio of it, the hand handHeads head heights long, the clavicles spread by `spread`; 0 heads keeps the model's lengths. Chosen on the human woman from desktop renders: 7.3 heads (the game's own woman stands 8.7 of her head heights, a realistic woman 7 to 7.5).
